text: Si ko woni, ɓe faala haasagol Muhammadu (saw) e wonndiiɓe makko ɓen dow kon ko Alla Okki ɓe immorde e Annabaaku e Liimanaaku e Ñiiɓugol ka leydi. Ko ɓe haasaŋtoo ɓe ? Gomɗii Men Okkiino jurriya Ibraahiima on Deftere Jippinaande nden, e kon ko Men Wahyini e maɓɓe ko jeyaaka e Deftere nden, Men Okki ɓe laamu yaajungu !.
